idea_statement: Test the connection between 'Lead-lag price discovery between futures and cash instruments' and 'Delta hedging under short or long gamma exposure' through their shared context tag:cross-market-transmission. When 'One linked market moves while another remains temporarily stale' and 'A directional move changes estimated net hedge demand materially' overlap, test whether the joint footprint appears more strongly, earlier, or in a different instrument than either mechanism alone. Observables: A statistically ordered response of cash, ETF or component prices after a futures move; Continuation into the final part of the session when hedgers are plausibly short gamma.
